line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.method: Compiled both mode expressions extracted from the current and pinned SetupConsoleMode. Applied them to a private native CONIN$ using GetConsoleMode/SetConsoleMode with and without stream I/O and initially enabled/disabled QuickEdit.
verification.scope: Console mode and exact restoration observed. No physical click or full guest test.

decision: Retain R1146 pending owner. Native QuickEdit is disabled while guest owns input; nt_event restores the saved mode on handoff, and SetupConsoleMode reapplies the guest selection on resume.
